description: Returns a link that opens Audiala's trip planner for one city, in a browser or in the Audiala mobile app, together with up to 8 places in that city that have an audio guide. Use this when the user asks to plan a trip to that city with Audiala, or to continue planning in Audiala. This tool does not build an itinerary and returns no day-by-day plan: the planner does that after the user opens the link. Read-only.
